name: DOAJ
summary: Index of open access journals and articles, with search, an API and open metadata dumps.
description: The Directory of Open Access Journals indexes peer-reviewed open access journals and articles worldwide. Search journals and articles, query the REST API, OAI-PMH, journal CSV, XML, OpenURL or the public data dump, and follow the publisher application process. Run by a non-profit Danish foundation; the homepage itself returned 403 to our crawler.
